traits.name: Formation
traits.text: When it's adjacent to at least two other allies, the hobgoblin soldier gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 to Reflex saves against area effects.

traits.name: Crossbow Precision
traits.text: The first time the archer hits with a crossbow attack in a round, it deals 1d8 (1d8) extra precision damage.

traits.name: Perfect Aim
traits.text: The hobgoblin archer ignores the concealed condition. Their targets don't benefit from lesser cover, and they reduce the AC bonus from standard cover by 2 against the hobgoblin archer's attack.

traits.name: Running Reload
traits.text: ⬻ The archer Strides, Steps, or Sneaks, then Interacts to reload.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ crossbow +14 (range increment 120 feet, reload 1); Damage 1d8+2 (1d8+2) piercing plus crossbow precision
